title: SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation
method: Original PDF page rendered with Poppler at 200 dpi, cropped only; no redrawing or generated images.

figures.original_caption_text: Figure 1: Humanoid Loco-manipulation in SIMPLE. We introduce a comprehensive simulation benchmark designed to standardize the evaluation and training of humanoid foundation models. The framework features 60 diverse whole-body tasks across 50 indoor scenes, utilizing over 1,000 object assets. By coupling MuJoCo’s robust contact physics with Isaac Sim’s photorealistic rendering, SIMPLE provides built-in data collection pipelines and natively benchmarks state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs (e.g., Ψ 0 [1], π 0.5 [2], DreamZero [3]).

figures.original_caption_text: Figure 2: System Pipeline. Our pipeline consists of three stages: (1) data generation in MuJoCo via motion planning and teleoperation; (2) offline replay and rendering in Isaac Sim to obtain photore- alistic visual observations; and (3) policy evaluation under diverse domain-randomized settings.
